requirementsSummary: Implement the approved Documentation Governance model (Design 009) for the source repository: create a durable governance policy, separate admin/support documentation, build a documentation audit matrix, cleanse end-user help of internal OMA/repo-development details, resolve the skill-katalog, link entry/reference docs to governance, give technical MCP/credential/CLI docs clear audiences, and verify the runtime/help pipeline runs.

C1.description: Durable governance policy exists with core rules from Design 009.
C1.verification: docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md exists; contains Serena Memory, docs/admin-support, docs/pros-hilfe-src, SSOT, AGENTS.md, .agents, and a checklist.

C2.description: Admin/support documentation has a dedicated home with index and clear scope.
C2.verification: docs/admin-support/README.md exists; mentions Admin, Support, Endnutzer and references technical setup/credential/MCP/troubleshooting content or its destinations.

C3.verification: Audit matrix in docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md or docs/admin-support/README.md; includes README.md, docs/pros-hilfe-src/endnutzerhandbuch.md, docs/pros-hilfe-src/skill-katalog.md, docs/CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md, docs/MCP-CREDENTIALS.md, runtime/pros/pros-runtime-manifest.md, .serena/memories.

C4.description: End-user help contains no internal OMA/repo-development details.
C4.verification: docs/pros-hilfe-src/*.md contains no forbidden internal markers (oma-, ultrawork, ralph, scm, gh-cli, .agents/skills, AGENTS.md, docs/plans, runtime-builder, CI, release-check) unless in a documented exception/audit line.

C5.description: Skill-katalog is cleansed as end-user artifact, replaced, or removed from help pipeline.
C5.verification: python scripts/generate-pros-hilfe.py --list exits 0; output/script contains no skill-katalog, OR docs/pros-hilfe-src/skill-katalog.md contains no internal skill/workflow names.

C6.description: Repo entry/reference docs reference governance instead of duplicating rules.
C6.verification: ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PLANS.md, docs/design-docs/index.md, and README.md contain a reference to docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md.

C7.description: Technical MCP/credential/CLI docs have clear audiences and do not contradict runtime SSOT.
C7.verification: docs/CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md and docs/MCP-CREDENTIALS.md contain audience hints or links to docs/admin-support/README.md; docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md names runtime/pros/pros-runtime-manifest.md as runtime SSOT.

C8.description: Runtime/documentation verification runs successfully or documents a real blocker.
C8.verification: generate-pros-hilfe.py --list, validate-runtime-files.js, npm run lint exit 0; or blocker documented in 029 progress/decision log.

apiContract.rationale: Design 009 and plan 029 Decision Log both confirm no service-API boundary is involved. The work spans documentation placement, runtime help generation (an existing Python script + JS validator), and repo validation. There is no frontend/backend or inter-service contract to specify. An API contract artifact would add no value and would be dead documentation.
apiContract.alternativeConsidered: Could have defined a 'data contract' for the DOCUMENTS dict in generate-pros-hilfe.py, but that is a single-file internal constant, not an API; it is handled as an inline acceptance criterion in T9.

tasks.title: Dokumentationsinventar und Audit-Matrix erstellen
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory covers every file named in C3 verification (README.md, endnutzerhandbuch.md, skill-katalog.md, CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md, MCP-CREDENTIALS.md, pros-runtime-manifest.md, .serena/memories) plus notable Memory groups from Design 009.
Each row records: audience, lifetime, authority, current issue, target action, migration status.
Audit matrix is placed where C3 verification expects it (governance doc or admin-support README) — final placement decided in T2/T4 but content authored here.

tasks.title: docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md als dauerhafte Richtlinie erstellen
acceptanceCriteria: Includes documentation spaces, placement rules, OMA-development precedence, Memory rules, end-user/admin boundary, and a manual review checklist.
Explicitly names runtime/pros/pros-runtime-manifest.md as runtime SSOT (C7).
Contains the audit matrix or links it from docs/admin-support/README.md (C3).
Shorter than Design 009 and fit for daily use; references AGENTS.md and .agents without overriding them.

tasks.title: Leichte Querverweise in ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PLANS.md, docs/design-docs/index.md ergaenzen
acceptanceCriteria: ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PLANS.md, docs/design-docs/index.md each contain a link to docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md.
Existing boundary rules are not duplicated contradictorily.

tasks.title: docs/admin-support/** Zielstruktur einfuehren
acceptanceCriteria: docs/admin-support/README.md exists as index with clear scope; mentions Admin, Support, Endnutzer.
References technical setup, credential, MCP, and troubleshooting content or its destinations.
Setup/credentials/MCP/troubleshooting are separated from end-user help.
Hosts audit matrix if not placed in governance doc (C3).

tasks.title: README zu Einstieg und Index zurueckschneiden
acceptanceCriteria: README contains a link to docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md (C6).
README references developer, end-user, and admin/support destinations.
README remains an entry/index point, not a mixed full manual.

tasks.title: Endnutzerhandbuch bereinigen
acceptanceCriteria: docs/pros-hilfe-src/endnutzerhandbuch.md contains only end-user tasks, safety rules, simple escalation.
No forbidden internal markers (oma-, ultrawork, ralph, scm, gh-cli, .agents/skills, AGENTS.md, docs/plans, runtime-builder, CI, release-check) unless in a documented exception line.
Technical setup/MCP/credential/deep-troubleshooting moved out or clearly linked to admin-support.

tasks.title: Skill-Katalog neu entscheiden und bereinigen
acceptanceCriteria: Decision documented: remove, rename, or replace skill-katalog with curated user-facing capabilities.
If kept, docs/pros-hilfe-src/skill-katalog.md contains no internal skill/workflow names (oma-, ultrawork, scm, gh-cli).
Help-pipeline stays consistent with the chosen decision (coordinated with T9).

tasks.title: Technische MCP-/Credential-/CLI-Inhalte in Admin/Support-Doku konsolidieren
acceptanceCriteria: docs/CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md and docs/MCP-CREDENTIALS.md contain audience hints or links to docs/admin-support/README.md.
Credential/integration rules do not contradict runtime manifest or security docs.

tasks.title: PDF-Hilfe-Pipeline an neue Endnutzer-Doku anpassen
acceptanceCriteria: python scripts/generate-pros-hilfe.py --list exits 0 and shows only approved end-user help documents.
DOCUMENTS dict in generate-pros-hilfe.py reflects the T7 decision (no skill-katalog if removed).
Generated runtime PDFs match the cleansed docs/pros-hilfe-src sources.

tasks.title: Dokumentations-Governance-Checkliste als manuelles Gate dokumentieren
acceptanceCriteria: Checklist covers audience, SSOT, end-user purity, secrets/PII, runtime boundary, duplicates.
Checklist does not block OMA workflow execution (advisory except hard risks).
Checklist lives inside docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md or a clearly linked location.

tasks.title: Optionales automatisierbares Gate konzipieren oder minimal implementieren
acceptanceCriteria: Either a follow-up plan/tech-debt entry exists, or a small validator exists.
Automation starts advisory except for hard risks (secrets, internal details in end-user docs).

tasks.title: Release-/Runtime-Verifikation ausfuehren und dokumentieren
acceptanceCriteria: python scripts/generate-pros-hilfe.py --list exits 0.
node scripts/validate-runtime-files.js exits 0.
npm run lint exits 0.
Any blocker is documented in 029 Progress Notes/Decision Log.
Cleansed end-user docs are visible in runtime help artifacts.

tasks.title: Abschlussreview gegen Design 009
acceptanceCriteria: All Design 009 acceptance criteria verified.
All Ralph criteria C1-C8 verified against their verification commands.
Deviations documented in 029 Decision Log or tech-debt tracker.

parallelismPlan.note: Critical path: T1 -> T2 -> T4 -> T6 -> T7 -> T9 -> T12 -> T13. T3 and T8 can slip behind the critical path without blocking C-criteria.

assumptions: Plan 029's 13-task decomposition is the authoritative baseline; this plan refines it with criteria mapping and parallel waves, it does not contradict it.
Available implementation agents in this harness are docs, backend, and qa (per plan 029 agent column and oma skill set).
docs/pros-hilfe-src currently contains endnutzerhandbuch.md and skill-katalog.md (confirmed via glob); both need C4/C5 work.
docs/admin-support/ does not yet exist (confirmed via glob) — T4 is net-new.
docs/DOCUMENTATION-GOVERNANCE.md does not yet exist (confirmed via glob) — T2 is net-new.
generate-pros-hilfe.py DOCUMENTS dict currently registers both endnutzerhandbuch and skill-katalog (confirmed via grep).

All reference files for C6/C7/C8 exist (ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/PLANS.md, docs/design-docs/index.md, README.md, CLI-MCP-COMMANDS.md, MCP-CREDENTIALS.md, pros-runtime-manifest.md, validate-runtime-files.js) — confirmed via glob.
No service/API boundary exists, so no API contract artifact is produced.
T11 (automated gate) remains P2 and optional; it is not required by any C-criterion and must not block C8.

alternativesConsidered.option: Tactical README-only cleanup (ignore governance doc, admin-support, skill-katalog)
alternativesConsidered.rejected: Design 009 explicitly identifies missing content governance as the root cause, not one misplaced paragraph. A README-only fix would leave C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C7 unmet.
alternativesConsidered.source: Design 009 Chosen Approach; plan 029 Decision Log row 3.

alternativesConsidered.option: Full automated check-gate in this plan (promote T11 to P0)
alternativesConsidered.rejected: Design 009 phases the gate as manual-first (Phase 5), then automated-later. Making automation P0 would over-scope the MVP and risks blocking C8 on tooling that is advisory by design.

alternativesConsidered.option: Split docs work across frontend/maintainer agents instead of a single docs agent
alternativesConsidered.rejected: Plan 029 assigns the documentation tasks to a docs agent consistently; introducing more agents increases coordination overhead without parallelism benefit since most docs tasks are sequentially dependent (T1->T2->T4->T6).

alternativesConsidered.option: Produce an API contract for the DOCUMENTS dict
alternativesConsidered.rejected: Single-file internal constant, not an inter-service API; would be dead documentation. Handled inline as T9 acceptance criterion.

completeness.question: Is anything missing?
completeness.method: Mapped every Ralph criterion C1-C8 to at least one P0/P1 task; cross-checked each task against Design 009 Migration Phases 1-5 and Acceptance Criteria.

meta.question: Was the review done properly?
meta.method: Self-verified the completeness review: re-checked that (a) every criterion has a primary task with dependencies, (b) every Design 009 phase has tasks, (c) acceptance criteria are testable, (d) no criterion is left to a single optional P2 task.

overEngineering.question: Is this over-engineered?
overEngineering.method: Reviewed each task for speculative/MVP-bloat; confirmed governance doc stays shorter than Design 009 (T2 criterion), manual gate precedes automation (T10 before T11), and no task adds frameworks or tools beyond existing repo tooling.
decisions: T11 automated gate kept P2/optional — not required by any C-criterion.
No new validator framework introduced; T11 either reuses existing scripts or is a tech-debt entry.
README cleanup (T5) is link/index only, not a rewrite.
